body:
## Problem

`api/drummers/index.js` — the file `gearIndex.js`'s own header declares as its single **"Source of truth"** — still states the specific snare model **"Pearl Reference 14x6.5\" Brass"** as a verified fact (`gear.snare` field + `kitOverview` prose) for 5 drummers whose ground truth has *already* been corrected elsewhere on the site to "the specific snare model has not been independently verified":

| Drummer | `api/drummers/index.js` gear.snare | `verified` flag | extendedBios.js FAQ (already correct) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gene Hoglan (line 317) | `'Pearl Reference 14x6.5" Brass'` | `true`, sources are generic Pearl artist page + Drumeo article, neither names a snare model | "the specific snare model has not been independently verified" (extendedBios.js:403-406) |
| Ray Luzier (line 764) | `'Pearl Reference 14x6.5" Brass'` | `true`, `verifiedAt: '2026-08-08'`, sources generic Pearl/Sabian artist pages | extendedBios.js:5066-5069 |
| Nick Augusto (line 1969) | `'Pearl Reference 14x6.5" Brass'` | `false` (flag is honest, but the specific-model text is still stated as fact in `gear.snare` and in `kitOverview` prose) | extendedBios.js:6987-6988 |
| Ryan Van Poederooyen (line 2386) | `'Pearl Reference 14x6.5" Brass'` | `true`, `verifiedAt: '2026-02-03'`, sources are generic `pearldrum.com/en/artists` / `sabian.com/artists` (not drummer-specific) | extendedBios.js:6864-6866 |
| Jocke Wallgren (line 3193) | `'Pearl Reference Pure 14x6.5"'` | `true`, source is the generic `pearldrum.com/en/artists` roster page | extendedBios.js:3390-3393 |

This `api/drummers/index.js` fact feeds `packages/frontend/data/gearIndex.js` (GENERATED FILE, regenerated via `node scripts/build-gear-index.cjs`, "Source of truth: api/drummers/index.js"), which buckets all 5 of these drummers (plus Matt Halpern, whose *actual* snare is a verified, different model — his own signature `Pearl Matt Halpern Signature 14x6" Brass (MH1460/B)`, `verified: true`, `verifiedAt: '2026-10-21'`, real Sweetwater/Pearl/Meinl sources) into one `"Reference 14x6.5\" Brass"` series key. That generated index drives:
- `public/llms/gear-series/pearl-reference-14x6-5-brass.md` — states "a pro-grade snare drums choice used by 6 metal drummers" and lists all 6 as "standard configuration" with zero hedging
- the live `/gear/pearl/reference-14x6-5-brass/drummers-using` page
- `public/llms/gear-comparison/drummers-using-pearl-reference-pure.md` (hand-authored sibling mirror) also states Nick Augusto's "Pearl Reference 14"×6.5" Brass snare" as fact

Three *symptom* fixes already shipped this week (#10342/#10367 Van Poederooyen, #10371 Hoglan, #10374 Luzier) patched individual downstream `public/llms/comparisons/*.md` / `evolution/*.md` mirrors with a hedge, but none touched the actual `api/drummers/index.js` source-of-truth record or regenerated `gearIndex.js` — so the gear-series page, the live `/gear/pearl/.../drummers-using` page, and the gear-comparison mirror all still overclaim, and any future regen of `gearIndex.js` will keep re-deriving the same fabricated specificity. This is a recurring whack-a-mole pattern (`.agents/seo/learned-patterns.md` pattern) — fixing the root stops it at the source instead of chasing each new mirror.

## Fix

1. In `api/drummers/index.js`, for the 4 "Reference 14x6.5\" Brass" drummers (Gene Hoglan, Ray Luzier, Nick Augusto, Ryan Van Poederooyen) and the "Reference Pure 14x6.5\"" drummer (Jocke Wallgren):
   - Change `gear.snare` from the specific model string to a non-specific, honest value consistent with the extendedBios.js hedge, e.g. `'Pearl snare (specific model not independently verified)'` — match whatever phrasing convention the repo already uses elsewhere for hedged fields (check `drummerEvolution.js:19682`/`:20640` for the established phrasing: `'(the specific model has not been independently verified)'`).
   - Set `gear.verified: false` for Gene Hoglan, Ray Luzier, and Ryan Van Poederooyen (currently incorrectly `true`) and add a `notes` field matching Nick Augusto's existing pattern (`notes: '...'`).
   - Edit the `kitOverview` prose for all 5 drummers to drop the specific "14x6.5\" Brass" / "Pure 14x6.5\"" snare claim (e.g. Gene Hoglan's kitOverview line: `'The cornerstone of the Gene Hoglan drum set is a Pearl Reference Brass snare (14×6.5")...'` → something like `'...a Pearl snare (the specific model has not been independently verified)...'`).
2. Regenerate the derived index: `node scripts/build-gear-index.cjs` — confirm this removes all 5 drummers from the `"Reference 14x6.5\" Brass"` / `"Reference Pure 14x6.5\""` buckets in `packages/frontend/data/gearIndex.js` (dropping the bucket entirely if fewer than 2 drummers remain, per the file's own "Series used by fewer than 2 drummers are omitted" rule — if that empties the bucket to 0 real drummers, `public/llms/gear-series/pearl-reference-14x6-5-brass.md` and the live `/gear/pearl/reference-14x6-5-brass/drummers-using` page should be removed/404'd along with any sitemap entry, not left as a ghost page).
3. Hand-sync the hand-authored `public/llms/gear-comparison/drummers-using-pearl-reference-pure.md` mirror (lines ~12-52) to drop the Nick Augusto specific-snare claim the same way.
4. Do NOT touch Matt Halpern — his `gear.snare: 'Pearl Matt Halpern Signature 14x6" Brass (MH1460/B)'` is independently verified (`verifiedAt: '2026-10-21'`, Sweetwater/Pearl/Meinl sources) and is a genuinely different, distinct model from the "Reference 14x6.5\" Brass" bucket — out of scope.

## Verify

1. `grep -n "snare:" api/drummers/index.js` for the 5 drummer blocks — confirm none still read `'Pearl Reference 14x6.5" Brass'` or `'Pearl Reference Pure 14x6.5"'`.
2. `grep -n "14x6.5" public/llms/gear-series/pearl-reference-14x6-5-brass.md` (if the page still exists post-regen) — confirm it no longer lists Hoglan/Luzier/Augusto/Van Poederooyen/Wallgren as "standard configuration" users.
3. Re-run `node scripts/build-gear-index.cjs` and diff `packages/frontend/data/gearIndex.js` — confirm the bucket either drops to just Matt Halpern-equivalent entries or is removed per the "<2 drummers" rule, and no other bucket/series regressed.
4. `grep -rn "Pearl Reference 14x6.5\" Brass\|Reference Pure 14x6.5" public/llms/gear-comparison/drummers-using-pearl-reference-pure.md` — confirm the Nick Augusto paragraph no longer states the specific model as fact.
5. Spot-check `extendedBios.js` for the same 5 drummers is unchanged (it's already correct — this fix is one-directional, syncing `api/drummers/index.js` to match `extendedBios.js`, not the reverse).

## Done

`api/drummers/index.js`'s `gear.snare`/`kitOverview`/`verified` fields for Gene Hoglan, Ray Luzier, Nick Augusto, Ryan Van Poederooyen, and Jocke Wallgren match the already-correct "not independently verified" ground truth; `gearIndex.js` is regenerated from the corrected source; the gear-series page and gear-comparison mirror no longer present the fabricated-specificity snare model as fact for these 5 drummers.
title: SEO: api/drummers/index.js source-of-truth still states fabricated 'Pearl Reference 14x6.5" Brass' snare as verified fact for 5 drummers, feeding gearIndex.js + gear-series/gear-comparison mirrors
